snippet.title: CALL TO SUMMON by KenForest - Full Play (NO Commentary) Use a Flip Phone to Summon Objects! (2024)
snippet.description:
CALL TO SUMMON by KenForest 
https://kenforest.itch.io/call-to-summon
https://kenforest.itch.io
https://twitter.com/AndreyBugrin

This is a short game where you can use an old phone to summon objects by simply calling them. Use it to advance through the old complex, reminiscent of liminal spaces.
